中心负责存原始对话、跑抽取、发快照；每台机器上有个节点跟着同步，断了网也能自己继: The hub stores raw transcripts, runs extraction and publishes snapshots. A node on each machine follows along, and keeps organising locally when the network is down. Agents read what matters into context through one fixed entry point. Many devices and many agents share one copy, and by default it only runs on a trusted private network. Raw transcripts are the only source of truth; memory is just an index pointing at them.

对 LLM 来说，读一句组织好的话，比解析一堆碎片省力；碎片越零散，越容易自己补: For an LLM, reading one organised sentence costs less than parsing scattered fragments; the more scattered the fragments, the more likely the model fills the gaps itself.
碎片和字段串没有被组织成上下文，模型容易自己补全；完整句子把人和事、时间、因果说: Fragments and field dumps are not organised into context, so models fill the gaps. A complete sentence makes the who, the what, the time and the cause explicit, and is harder to misread.

句子由程序按模板拼；读侧不生成内容，也就不会在读取时编，还少一次往返。: Sentences are assembled by a template in code. Since nothing is generated on the read side, nothing can be invented at read time, and one round trip is saved.

为什么这么设计: Why it is built this way
每一条都对着一个真踩过的坑，不是为了复杂而复杂。: Each one answers a real trap we hit; nothing is complex for its own sake.
对话一关，上下文就没了: Close the conversation and the context is gone
原文永远留着，凭指针随时能找到: The raw text stays; a pointer finds it any time
模型会编，尤其在时间和数字上: Models invent, especially times and numbers
程序做定位，模型只判断语义: Code locates; the model only judges meaning
结论跟出处对不上，错也不知道错在哪: When a conclusion does not match its source, you cannot see where it went wrong
每条都带原文位置和时间，能撤销、能替换: Every row carries the source position and time; it can be retracted or superseded
换个模型就得重来一遍: Swap the model and everything has to be redone
记忆只存结论，原文不动，重跑一遍即可: Memory holds conclusions only; the raw text is untouched, so a re-run is enough
小机器上，向量模型太重: On a small machine, embedding models are too heavy
先用关键词精确召回；要向量再加可选表，不进核心: Start with exact keyword recall; add vectors as an optional table later, never in the core
一个人维护不动一堆服务: One person cannot maintain a fleet of services
单文件、只用 SQLite、没有消息队列: One binary, SQLite only, no message queue
没有外部服务、没有控制台窗口，拷过去就能跑。: No external services, no console window; copy it over and run.
没有中心时，本机就是中心；有了中心，它也只是多一个角色。: Without a hub, this machine is the hub; with one, it is just another role.
不引入消息队列、缓存和搜索集群；出了问题能直接打开看。: No message queue, cache or search cluster; when something breaks you can open the file and look.
断一天就在本地接着整理，断五天先自己当中心；网回来按固定顺序并回去。: One day offline, keep organising locally; five days, act as your own hub; when the network returns, merge back in a fixed order.
不是插件的副产品。: not a by-product of a plugin.
